steps.title: Getting started
steps.text: Talk to Adrasteia in the White Knights' Castle's throne room.
steps.warning: For the tracking to work properly, you need to have the chat visible, game messages set to 'On', and chat timestamps on.

steps.title: Clues in the prison
steps.text: Enter the ancient doors in the Varrock Dig Site.

Discover the large footprint downstairs. (1/5)
  • All discoverable entities in this quest should be marked by a red dot on your minimap.
Discover one of the bodies of demon cultists. (2/5)

Talk to Adrasteia again to continue.
  • You must dismiss followers for the following steps.

steps.title: Khazard
steps.text: Talk to one of the Khazard guards.
Talk to one of the guards again.
Reset the puzzle with one of the long chests until you're prompted to skip the puzzle.

actions.text: Yes, I'm ready to move on.

steps.title: Clues in Menaphos
steps.text: Enter the Grand Library in Menaphos.
Talk to Adrasteia in the library.
Discover The Corruption on the first level from top, near the south-eastern corner. (1/3)
Discover The Secret Chamber opposite The Corruption, in the south-western corner. (2/3)
Discover The Living Dead on the bottom level, near the north-eastern corner. (3/3)
Discover the imbued bones on the western side of the chamber. (1/3)
Discover the fragments of an obelisk next to the soul obelisk. (2/3)

steps.title: Vengeance and the Magister
steps.text:
Talk to Adrasteia.
  • You must dismiss followers and have no items for the following steps. Adrasteia can bank your items for you.

Defeat the Magister.
  • All prayers are disabled. Use abilities in order to win the fight.
  • If you die, you will be teleported to Menaphos gate. Enter the gate to return to the quest.
  • If you fail to defeat him twice, there will be an option to skip the combat phase.

actions.text: Yes, and skip this combat encounter (2 attempts).
Yes, I'm ready to move on.

steps.title: Preparing disguise in the Wilderness
steps.text: Talk to Adrasteia in the White Knights' Castle's throne room.
Mine the argonlike rocks for 28 argonlike ore north-east of Fort Forinthry in the wilderness.
Smelt at the furnace in the eastern ruins.
Smith at the anvil in the building west of the Mage Arena.
Talk to Adrasteia the Forgotten to the south-east up the stairs leading up to the Mage Arena.

Defeat the 3 waves of enemies.
  • You can use prayers. It is recommended to use magic protection prayers in waves 1, 2 and melee protection in wave 3.
  • After each enemy is defeated, restore your health with the health orbs.
  • If you fail a wave two times, the wave can be skipped to continue.

actions.text: Yes, and skip this combat encounter (2 attempts).

steps.text: Eavesdrop the defeated forgotten mage in the north. (2/4)
Eavesdrop the defeated forgotten mage in the south. (4/4)
steps.warning: Known issue: can't highlight the defeated forgotten mage.

actions.text: Yes, search the caves beneath the Mage Arena.

steps.warning: Known issue: No tracking for this step due to a quest bug at the time of development.

steps.text: Search the rune pouch in your backpack.
Take the white dust and choose the option empty rune pouch.
steps.warning: Known issue: No tracking for this step due to a quest bug at the time of development.

steps.text: Use the one measly fire rune on a sharp rock.
Talk to Adrasteia and choose the option inert fire rune fragments.

actions.text: [Show an item in your backpack to Adrasteia.]

steps.text: Use the pouch of white dust on the sparkling pool to the south.
Sabotage the modified ritual marker and choose the option volatile fire rune fragments.
Conceal the blatantly sabotaged ritual marker and choose the option soggy pouch of grey paste.

actions.text: Exit this cave and return to the deep Wilderness.

postconditions.text: furthest from me on my right

steps.title: The coronation and usurpation
steps.warning: Clicking out of the dialogue after any of the cutscenes will cause you to rewatch the cutscenes.

steps.text:
Kill 10 forgotten warriors.
  • Use the abilities via the interface at the top of the screen. Make frequent use of the Blast ability (3) to kill multiple enemies around you.
